notes.title: Multiplayer full release! - v1.03 - 21/06/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/a7fb639d9028d34e8851957447c83686988fc8ad.gif[/img]
Howdy folks,

[b]Multiplayer[/b] is now fully released! There have been no issues reported so I believe it should be stable. As always if you find something let me know.

It now supports 1 player, 2 player and 4 player, Multiplayer Leaderboards are now also working and many small fixes.

Cheers!

--------

v1.03 - 21/06/2017

 * Multiplayer Defense Full Release!
 * Supports solo, 2 player and 4 player
 
 * Added Multiplayer Leaderboards
 * Multiplayer default name is your Steam name
 * Crate UI flashes when spawning
 * Crate spawn animation
 * Last personal best is now visible
 * Workshop sprites can now be used and will be synced with other players
 * Lobby now shows player count
 * Create game now supports choosing 1 player, 2 player or 4 player
 * Objects are now correctly synced and can be countered

notes.title: Multiplayer update! - v1.02 - 10/06/2017
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/0cef9bf2f02a19817e4edb19f84530e0302c1cf5.gif[/img]
Howdy folks!

The most requested feature, [b]Multiplayer,[/b] is finally here!

Fight alongside a friend and defend your buildings!
Pick your upgrades and fight wisely, higher hit counter equals higher score!

It is currently in [b]Beta[/b] so please let me know if you find something odd. This has been a monumental task so I really need your help to make sure it is rock solid.

Once I am confident that the multiplayer foundation is solid I can start looking into other game modes like Campaign Co-op, 4 Player Defense on a more complex Castle map, PVP mode and so on.

Hope you have fun!
Cheers!

--------

v1.02 - 10/06/2017

* Added Multiplayer Defense!
* Fight alongside a friend and defend your buildings!
* Pick your upgrades and fight wisely, higher hit counter equals higher score!

* Multiplayer mode is currently in beta so please let me know if you find something odd

* Fixed Dash flash not visible
* Fixed bug with Flurry and Super Slash if enemy died during animation
